reading: SpaceX caught the top part of its Starship rocket for the first time.
The flight lasted twenty-two and a half hours.
The top part travelled around Earth 14 times before coming back.
The launch tower’s arms caught it when it returned to Earth.
Workers cheered as the rocket returned to the launch area in Texas.
SpaceX also wanted to catch the bottom part, but this did not happen.
The bottom part went to the ocean and exploded.
SpaceX wants to use both parts again to make flights cost less.
